tasks.title: Implement runPromptWithHangRecovery shared function
tasks.description: Implement the core `runPromptWithHangRecovery()` function in `packages/cli/src/agent-runtime/acp-session.ts`. This function wraps `connection.prompt()` with idle-based hang detection (setInterval polling every 30s, configurable via `hangIdleMs`, default 180000ms) and recovery flow (WIP commit → cancel → 1s cooldown → re-prompt with recovery hint). Add `hangIdleMs` to `AcpSessionOptions` and `AcpConnectionOptions` interfaces. The function should emit `coder_recovery_status` SSE events and write `acp_session_hang_detected`, `acp_session_recovery_started`, `acp_session_recovery_succeeded`, `acp_session_recovery_failed` to workflow_log. Max 2 recovery attempts. Degradation: cancel timeout (5s) → kill + return `[HANG_UNRECOVERABLE] cancel timed out`; max attempts exceeded → kill + return `[HANG_UNRECOVERABLE] max recovery attempts exceeded`. See design.md D1–D4 for implementation approach.
acceptanceCriteria: runPromptWithHangRecovery function exported from acp-session.ts with PromptWithRecoveryParams interface
AcpSessionOptions and AcpConnectionOptions include hangIdleMs?: number field
When hangIdleMs=0, no idle monitoring occurs (function behaves like plain prompt)
When idle threshold exceeded, recovery sequence executes: emit detected → WIP commit → cancel → cooldown → prompt with hint
cancel() is raced against 5-second timeout; timeout triggers kill + [HANG_UNRECOVERABLE] error
Max 2 recovery attempts; 3rd hang returns [HANG_UNRECOVERABLE] max recovery attempts exceeded
coder_recovery_status SSE events emitted at detected/recovering/recovered/failed lifecycle points
workflow_log events written: acp_session_hang_detected, acp_session_recovery_started, acp_session_recovery_succeeded, acp_session_recovery_failed
When agent completes normally (no hang), no recovery events are emitted or logged
setInterval timer is cleared on all exit paths (success, error, kill)
cd packages/cli && npx tsc --noEmit
tasks.notes: This is the largest task. The function uses getter/setter callbacks for mutable state (lastEventTime, hasRecovered, recoveryAttemptCount) to integrate with the existing closure pattern. See design.md D2 for the interface signature. Emit SSE events via eventBus.emit('coder_recovery_status', ...) — the event type is registered in T-001.

For `createAcpConnection`, reset recoveryAttemptCount to 0 at the start of each `prompt()` call. Remove the old timeout-only prompt handling code that is now replaced by the shared function.
